name: v0.3.16 — Stash horizontal-scroll category strip · Stash aggregator central engine
releaseNotes:
• Stash category-filter strip is now a single horizontal-scroll row on both web and mobile. Web was wrapping across 3 lines on wide screens; mobile pills now carry their category's brand color in the active state with a bigger emoji bubble (matches web visual richness).
• Stash aggregation engine centralized — one source of truth at web/src/lib/stashEngine.js, mirrored in mobile/lib/services/stash_engine.dart. Same grouping rules everywhere: SKU-or-name key, case-insensitive, returned + statement-import rows filtered, multi-store merge, ratings tracked as max + avg.
• 20-scenario Stash aggregator test report: 74/74 web + 20/20 mobile assertions green. PDF at /stash-scenario-report.pdf.
• v0.3.15 (Stash pill polish) bundled here since it was on-device only — first time it ships to other users via auto-update.
